'''E9-L4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and stationed near the canyons of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].

==Biography==
The droid's primary programming was to inform other Imperial and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces that some scrambled excavator droids posed a serious problem. The astromech droid suggested a reprogramming of these excavator droids as a solution for the Empire to utilize these for the ongoing Imperial operation.<ref name="Scrapyard" />
